'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Kurdish–Turkish conflict (1978–present)|Kurdish–Turkish conflict]]
**[[Operation Claw-Sword]]
***[[Syrian Democratic Forces]] [[commander-in-chief]] [[Mazloum Abdi]] suspends military operations against the [[Islamic State]] in order to focus on preparations for a [[Turkey|Turkish]] ground invasion of [[Autonomous Administration of North and East Syria|northern Syria]]. [https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2022/11/turkeys-strikes-syria-put-us-troops-danger-pentagon-says (Al Monitor)]
*[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Southern Ukraine campaign]]
***At least 15 people are killed and 35 others are injured when [[Russian Armed Forces]] [[Bombardment|bombard]] [[Kherson]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/russian-shelling-kills-15-in-kherson-as-ukraine-battles-to-restore-power-3554546 (AFP via NDTV)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Modern immigration to the United Kingdom]]
**[[Net migration rate|Net migration]] to the [[United Kingdom]] reaches a record of 504,000 in 2022, according to the [[Office for National Statistics]]. The record increase is primarily due to non-[[European Union|EU]] migration, the resumption of post-[[COVID-19 pandemic|pandemic]] travel, the arrival of [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] and [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] refugees, and immigration from [[Hong Kong]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-63743259 (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Mahsa Amini protests]]
**The [[United Nations Human Rights Council]] approves the establishment of a [[United Nations fact-finding mission|fact-finding mission]] into the allegations of [[Human rights in Iran|human rights]] violations committed by the [[Government of the Islamic Republic of Iran|Iranian government]] in response to the protests. [https://www.news24.com/news24/world/news/un-rights-council-orders-international-probe-of-iran-crackdown-20221124 (AFP via News24)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Philippine drug war]]
**[[Killings of Kian delos Santos, Carl Arnaiz and Reynaldo de Guzman]]
***A [[Regional Trial Court]] in [[Caloocan]], [[Philippines]], sentences a [[Philippine National Police|police]] officer to [[life imprisonment]] for torturing and [[False evidence|fabricating evidence]] on drug war victims Carl Arnaiz and Reynaldo de Guzman in 2017. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippines-court-delivers-rare-conviction-police-officer-drugs-war-violations-2022-11-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[2021 Algeria wildfires]]
**A court in [[Algeria]] sentences 49 people [[Capital punishment in Algeria|to death]] for the [[lynching]] of a 38-year-old man during last year's [[wildfires]], after the man turned himself to police on suspicion of [[arson]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20221124-algerian-court-sentences-49-people-to-death-over-forest-fire-lynching (AFP via France 24)]
*[[China–United Kingdom relations]]
**The [[Government of the United Kingdom]] orders [[Departments of the Government of the United Kingdom|its departments]] to remove and refrain from installing [[closed-circuit television]] systems manufactured by [[List of companies of China|companies]] that are under [[National Intelligence Law of the People's Republic of China|China's national intelligence law]] at "sensitive" buildings, citing security concerns. [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/11/25/uk-restricts-chinese-cameras-in-government-buildings-over-security-fears.html (CNBC)]
*Three people are killed and another is injured as a gunman opens fire at a shopping centre in [[Krymsk]], [[Krasnodar Krai]], [[Russia]]. The perpetrator commits suicide after the attack. [https://www.outlookindia.com/international/russia-shooting-3-people-dead-in-krymsk-as-66-year-old-gunman-open-fire-later-kills-himself-news-239931 (Outlook)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Malaysian general election]]
**[[Pakatan Harapan]] and long-time [[Leader of the Opposition (Malaysia)|opposition]] leader [[Anwar Ibrahim]] is sworn in as the [[Prime Minister of Malaysia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/malaysias-former-ruling-bloc-may-back-anwar-pm-race-2022-11-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russian gay propaganda law]]
**The lower house of the Russian parliament, the [[State Duma]], passes a bill banning all instances of "[[LGBT]] propaganda". [https://www.reuters.com/world/russias-parliament-passes-law-banning-lgbt-propaganda-among-adults-2022-11-24/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 FIFA World Cup]]
**[[Portugal at the FIFA World Cup]]
***[[Portuguese people|Portuguese]] footballer [[Cristiano Ronaldo]] becomes the first player to score a [[Goal (sports)#Association football|goal]] at five [[FIFA Men's World Cup]] tournaments after scoring one in [[Portugal national football team|Portugal]]'s [[2022 FIFA World Cup Group H#Portugal vs Ghana|3–2 win]] against [[Ghana national football team|Ghana]].
